mapper.select: SELECT mp.id, mp.match_id, mp.steam_id, sa.nick_name, mp.hero_id, mp.kills, mp.deaths, mp.assists, mp.win, mp.gold_per_min, mp.xp_per_min, mp.last_hits, mp.denies, mp.hero_damage, mp.tower_damage, mp.hero_healing, mm.start_time, mm.duration, mm.game_mode, mm.lobby_type, mp.created_time FROM match_player mp LEFT JOIN steam_account sa ON mp.steam_id = sa.steam_id LEFT JOIN match_main mm ON mp.match_id = mm.match_id WHERE mp.match_id = #{matchId} ORDER BY mp.hero_id

WITH target_matches AS ( SELECT DISTINCT mp.match_id FROM match_player mp JOIN match_main mm ON mp.match_id = mm.match_id WHERE mp.steam_id = #{steamId} AND mm.game_mode = #{gameMode} ), match_scores AS ( SELECT mp.match_id, mp.steam_id, mp.hero_id, mp.win, mp.kills, mp.deaths, mp.assists, (mp.kills + mp.assists + 0.0) * GREATEST(mp.gold_per_min, 1) / (GREATEST(mp.deaths, 0) + 1) + mp.hero_damage / 100.0 AS score FROM match_player mp WHERE mp.match_id IN (SELECT match_id FROM target_matches) ), ranked AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, win ORDER BY score DESC) AS rn FROM match_scores ) SELECT mp.hero_id, COUNT(*) AS games, SUM(CASE WHEN mp.win THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, ROUND(AVG(mp.kills), 1) AS avg_kills, ROUND(AVG(mp.deaths), 1) AS avg_deaths, ROUND(AVG(mp.assists), 1) AS avg_assists, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mp.win AND r.rn = 1 AND r.steam_id = mp.steam_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS mvp, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT mp.win AND r.rn = 1 AND r.steam_id = mp.steam_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS fmvp FROM match_player mp JOIN match_main mm ON mp.match_id = mm.match_id LEFT JOIN ranked r ON r.match_id = mp.match_id AND r.steam_id = mp.steam_id WHERE mp.steam_id = #{steamId} AND mm.game_mode = #{gameMode} GROUP BY mp.hero_id ORDER BY games DESC
